data.alternative: salloc -p cpu -N 1 -t 2:00:00 -c 4   # then: srun --pty bash -l   (exit twice to release the node)
notes: clusterwand does not open shells. Run these yourself: first connect to the login node, then start the session.
The session is billed until it ends: exit as soon as you are done.
Do not run heavy work on the login node itself; that is what the interactive session is for.
